calls.title: Notion + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team discussed the integration of Snowflake with GrowthBook, noting that while the Snowflake connection has been established, metric migration and SDK setup are delayed due to manual adjustments and additional time required for exposure forwarding. The Proof of Concept (POC) start is postponed to after July 4th to ensure quality setup. The onsite meeting is rescheduled for late July to align better with project timelines. Pricing discussions are deferred, as the team expressed concerns about potential high costs related to event forwarding. The procurement process was outlined, emphasizing legal review timelines and a preference for flexible, tiered pricing models. Ongoing communication will be maintained via Slack, with offline syncs planned for technical details.

calls.title: Notion<>GrowthBook - Onsite Meeting
calls.summary: The call involved Notion's data/experimentation team (Sam, Snehal, Jeff) and GrowthBook's team (Luke, Graham, Jake) discussing GrowthBook's vision, AI features, scalability, and customization for experimentation, contrasting it with their current platform, Statsig. Key pain points included experiment governance, metric quality, capturing learnings at scale, and reliable feature flag rollouts. Next steps: Notion will run real experiments over the next month; Jake will send a recap and gather feedback
